origin.origins.human.description:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
He māmā ake te tūnga o te tangata i te nuinga o te hunga - haere tonu me te kore painga, he kino rānei.
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.name: Ko Alfiq
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.description:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Ko te Takoha Kore Roroa§r
§o§2+ He nekehanga ahurei§r
§o§6• Te kai kikokiko§r
§o§c- Te Tiakitanga§r
§lKo Alfiq§r He momo mōrearea o ngā ngārara anthropomorphic me ngā makawe koi me te āta pai. He maha ngā huarahi e arahi ana ki ngā one wera..
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.name: Ko te Arachnae
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.descript:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Te Wawa, Te Whakahaere i te Rōpū
+ Te Heke i te Taiepa§r
§o§6• Te kai kikokiko§r
§o§c- Te Hiakai, te Pirihimana§r
He whakakotahitanga whakamataku o te ngārara me te tangata, he ngārara matū, he waewae ngārara, engari he kaha ki te hikoi tika, ki te hopu i ngā patu.
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.name: Ko te Banshee
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.descripti:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Rererangi, Tautoko, Taahiraa§r
§o§6• Ko te hunga ora
§o§c- Te Tiakitanga§r
§o§c- Ngā huringa tino nui, pānuihia tuatahi!§r
§lNgā kōtiro§r I roto i te pakiwaitara, ka whakaarotia to rātau aroaro he tohu o te mate..
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.name: He mea whakaraerae
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.descripti:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Ngā Takoha Raro
§o§6• E hāngai ana ki te ahi
§o§c- Kua Pakaru i te Wai§r
§o§c- He ngoikore i roto i te Ao Rawa§r
§lKo te Incubi§r Ko nga kaimahi kino o te kaha pouri. He kaha ratou i roto i to ratou ake rangatiratanga, engari hei utu i tenei i hoatu e ratou to ratou wairua, a he ngoikore ki nga puna ma.
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.name: Ngārara
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.description:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Te mahi maina, te hanga ana i ngā ana§r
§o§6• He poto: 102cm.3'7"§r
§o§c- He ngoikore ki te rā 
- Kāore e mōhio ki te kaukau.§r
§lNgā ngārara§r he mea mahi, he mea whakakake, he mea whakakake, he tino pai ki te maina me te noho i raro i te whenua, engari he uaua ki te marama o te ra..
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.name: Ko te Elf Rākau
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.descript:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Ngā Tohu Whanui, Tere§r
§o§6• He tūpāpaku, he kai kākano§r
§o§c- Te Tiakitanga§r
§lNgā Ngārara Rākau§r He iwi whakaaro nui, roa te ora e noho ana i runga i te whenua. He tere rātau ki te hoari me te kopere, ā, ka taea e rātau te tinihanga i ō rātou hoariri i waenganui i ngā rākau.
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.name: Ko te High Elf
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.descript:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Ngā Kaitohutohu, Ngā Āhuahira Motuhake§r
§o§c- Te Whara Tino
- Te Tiakitanga§r
§lNgā Elf Runga§r He tino whakapehapeha, ahakoa he tino pukenga; he kaha te rere o te mana o ngā huānga ki roto i ō rātou toto, ahakoa he ngoikore ake rātou ki ngā patu.
origin.medievalorigins.fae.name: Ko te Fae
origin.medievalorigins.fae.description:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Te Whakatere, te Magic§r
§o§6• He poto: 122cm.4'0"§r
§o§c- E Arohatia Ana e te Rōpū Tangata§r
§lKo te Fae§r Ko ngā mea whakamiharo o te ngahere o te ngahere, he ahuareka, he mea whakamiharo ki te makutu o te taiao, ā, he tino hononga ki ngā ngahere i ahu mai ai rātau.
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.name: Ko te Goblin
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.descriptio:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Nga Tohu Whakapaipai Koura§r
§o§2+ Te waimarie, te tere§r 
§o§6• Iti: 92cm.3'3"§r 
§o§c- Hauora, Tiaki§r
§lKo ngā ruānuku§r Kei te āwangawanga ki te koura me te taonga, ā, ka kitea ētahi atu taonga i ngā wāhi katoa e titiro ana rātou, engari ko tō rātou rahi iti, he ngoikore rātou i te pakanga.
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.name: Ko te Gorgon
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.descriptio:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Te Whakangaromanga o te Wawa, Te Pūāhua§r
§o§2+ Te whakahaere i te mano tini§r
§o§c- Ko te waipiro 
- Ngā ngoikoretanga motuhake§r
§lNgā Gorgons§r He mea kanga ngā mea hanga i mua i te tangata, he makawe i hangaia ki te nakahi, he kanohi whakamataku, e kiia ana e whakamataku ana i te hunga e kite ana i taua mea.
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.name: Ko te Moon Elf
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.descript:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Te kino o te tao
+ Ko te rākau§r
§o§6• He Rere, Kāore e Moe§r
§o§c- Te Tiakitanga§r
He mea ngaro, he mea kore o tēnei ao. engari mō te mea anake ka kite a rātau patunga i mua i to rātau mutunga..
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.name: Ngārara
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.description:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Ngā Takoha Axe, Tiaki §r
§o§6• He nui: 268cm.9'5"§r
§o§c- Te Hiakai, te Tere §r
§lNgārara§r He momo nui, he ngoikore, he kararehe o ngā Orc. Ko ō rātou rahi nui, me ō rātou pūkenga iti, he mea hanga mā tō rātou kaha..
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.name: Ko te Pixie
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.description:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ He Rererangi Motuhake, He Motuhake§r
§o§6• Iti: 22cm.9" §r
§o§c- Te Tiaki, te Ingoa §r
I te nuinga o te wā e whakaarotia ana he kaiwhakarato o te waimarie pai, engari he hunga tinihanga hoki, he hunga kore e taea te whakawhirinaki ki te mahi kino..
origin.medievalorigins.plague_victim.nam: Ko te Patunga o te Mate uruta
origin.medievalorigins.plague_victim.des:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Te whakangaro §r
§o§6• He kāhua tākaro ahurei §r
§o§6• Ko te hunga ora §r
§o§c- Te Tiaki, te Ingoa 
§o§c- He uaua§r
Ko ngā mea mate-mate e pāngia ana e te mate, e kore nei e taea te karanga he tangata, kua kanga, kua mau hoki ki roto i te mamae mutungakore nā tētahi mate mīharo..
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.name: Ko te Revenant
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.descript:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Te whakaingoatanga §r
§o§2+ He pai ki a Illager 
§o§6• Ko te hunga ora, he matatini §r
§o§c- Te ingoa
- Ngā pātahitanga ora §r
§lKo ngā Revenants§r Ko ngā wairua e mate ana i ngā mate whakamataku me te mamae, engari i hoki mai anō ki te ora, ā, i te mutunga, ka tino hiahia rātou ki te whakahaere i te ora me te mate o ētahi atu mea ora..
origin.medievalorigins.siren.name: He puoro
origin.medievalorigins.siren.description:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ E hāngai ana ki te wai, Whakamahi §r
§o§6• He ngoikore ake i runga i te whenua§r
§o§c- He māmā ki te ahi§r
§lKo ngā wherikotanga§r E kīia ana he momo Merfolk rātou. E kīia ana ko to rātau ataahua e kore e taea te aukati i te hinganga o te nuinga o ngā kaipuke kuware..
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.name: Ko te Yeti
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.description:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Ko te pūtake o te hukarere, Tanky§r
§o§6• Nui: 203cm.6'8"§r
§o§c- He ngoikore ki te wera§r
Ko ngā kararehe huruhuru matotoru mai i ngā ngahere makariri, ko te mana o te Yeti i runga i te hukapapa e āhei ai ki a rātau te whakamakuku i ngā hoariri, engari he tino māmā rātau ki ngā whakaeke ahi.
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.name: Ko te ngārara
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.descript:
§l§nTirohanga whānui§r: 
§o§2+ Te whakaora§r 
§o§6• Ko ngā parirau parirau§r 
§o§c- He ngoikore ki te Kore-mate§r
§lKo te ngārara§r He toa parirau kore wehi e whakatau ana i te mate o te hunga e whawhai ana; e kiia ana i kawea e rātau te hunga mate ki te Valhalla o Odin
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.name: He ngutu ngutu
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.descr: Kei a Alfiq ngā makawe ārai ārai; he nui ake te kino e pā ana ki a rātau ki ngā waewae kore, ā, ka taea e rātau te piki me te piri ki ngā mata pakari (Ka taea te whakawhiti)
I te taha o te rā ka heke, ka tere ake te nekehanga me te whakaeke a Alfiq. I ētahi atu wā, he ngoikore, he puhoi ake hoki.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.on_your_feet: Mēnā, i a koe e tū ana, e titiro tika ana koe ki raro, kaua e pāngia e te hinga.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pickpocket.d: Pāwhiritia te taha matau o tētahi kainoho i a koe e tūpāpaku ana me ngā waewae kau mō te whai wāhitanga ki te tahae i ētahi emerala. Ka mau rānei koe. E ai ki ngā kōrero ka taea pea e koe te tahae i ētahi atu kaitākaro.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.name: Whakapā atu
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.descr: Whai muri i te whakapapa poto me te kore e neke ki te whakaeke, ka taea e te Alfiq te peke ki mua i te tawhiti nui.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.poor_grip.de: Kua whakaitihia e Alfiq te tere o te pakaru mā ngā taputapu, me te whakaiti i te kino mā ngā patu ā-ringa pēnei i ngā hoari me ngā tuaka.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.agile_prefer: E pai ana a Alfiq ki te mau i ngā kākahu māmā anake mō te māmā o te nekehanga. Ka taea te mau i ngā kākahu taumaha me te kore he whiu mā te whakamāramatanga.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.meow.name: Meow (whānau)
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.bottomles: He Ngutu Kāore i te Runga
E hiahia ana ngā arachnae ki te nui ake o te kai kia ora ai.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.brittle.d: He uaua te nekehanga o te exoskeleton chitinous o te Arachnae mēnā he taumaha ake i te rino te kākahu. Ka taea te ārai i tēnei mā te whakapā.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.climber.d: Ko ngā huruhuru pai i runga i ngā waewae o te Arachnae ka taea ai e rātau te piki i ngā pakitara.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.fragile_e: Ko te exoskeleton o te Arachnae he morearea ake ki te kino. He iti ake te hauora o rātau i te tangata noa.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.many_eyes: Ko ngā kanohi e waru o te Arachnae kua whakaritea ki te pōuri, ā, ka āhei ki a rātau te kite mārama ahakoa he iti rawa te marama.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.venomous_: Kei roto i ngā niho o Arachnae te waikura, ā, ko ia whakaeke he tūponotanga ki te tuku waikura.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.spectral.d: Kei a Banshees te āheinga kia kore e taea te hopu, ka neke noa i roto i te ao ā-tinana me te kore e taea te taunekeneke ki a ia. He nui te pūngao e whakamahia ana e tēnei, ā, kāore e taea te whakahohe i te wā e iti ana te hiakai.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.name: Kua whakatoia
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.desc: I ngā wā katoa ka patua, he iti noa iho te tūponotanga ka tukua te kaiwhakatuma ki te mate puhoi, mamae.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.immaterial: He haurua te hauora o ngā Banshees i te tangata ora.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.dimeritium: Ko ngā konganuku whakamiharo, pēnei i te rino, i te hiriwa rānei, kāore e taea e ngā banshees te whakaae.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.lunar_nexu: Ko te hononga o te Marama
Kāore e taea e ngā Banshees te whakahoki mai i te hiakai mai i te kai - ka whakahokia mai a rātau pūngao e te marama tika anake, heoi, kāore e taea e rātau te hiakai.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.sonic_shri: Ka āta whakatupato a Banshee i te matenga. Ka taea e rātau te tuku i tētahi rerenga taringa, e akiaki ana i ngā mea e tata ana, e karanga ana i tētahi porowhita iti e tiaki ana. Ka pōhēhē ngā ūnga e pā tika ana ki te rerenga.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_sig: Ka nui ake te kino i te wā e hopu ana koe i tētahi patu kanga.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_war: Ka ārai koe i ētahi atu kino mō ia wahi o te whakangungu i mau.
Ko te mate toto o te incubus e kore e taea te makona. Ki te kore he kikokiko o te kararehe, he kore utu.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.demon_fire: He kaha ake ngā Incubi ki ngā pūkenga ahi katoa, ā, ka taea e rātau te tuku i te mura o te mura i a rātau e hiahia ana.
Ka rite te ahi ki te kāinga - e kore e kino ki a Incubi, e makona ana hoki.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.hydrophobe: Ka wera te wai i te Incubi, ka whara i a rātau i te whakapā.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.impure.des: Ka tangohia e ngā Incubi ētahi atu kino mai i a Smite, ā, ka hurihia ngā pānga mai i te whakaora me te whara.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.dimension_: Kāore ngā Incubi i te whakamahia ki ngā āhuatanga e whiti ana te rā, ā, he ngoikore ake i reira, engari he kaha ake rātau i roto i te Nether.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.unholy_dea: Ka taea e tētahi incubus te whakawhiti i tētahi wāhanga o tōna kaha ora ki te pūngao raw mō tētahi wā poto.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.darkness_dwe: Ka noho i roto i te pōuri
Ka tahuna e te māramatanga o te rā ngā kanohi o te ngārara, ā, ka matapo ā-tahitanga, ka taea te ārai mā te whakamāramatanga, mā te potae koura rānei.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.name: He matotoru
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.descri: He tino taumaha nga ngeru mō to rātau rahi; ka hohoro te ruku i roto i te wai.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dwarven_tech: Ka taea e nga Dwarves te keri i te kohatu me te kore he pihi, me te keri i tetahi mea tere atu i era atu.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.miniature.de: He iti noa iho nga Dwarves kia uru ki roto i te awheawhe 1 mita te teitei (me te tata ki te whanui).
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.nocturnal_ey: Ka taea e ngā ngārara te arotahi ki te kite mārama me te kore e hiahiatia he pūtake marama.
E mōhiotia ana ngā Dwarf mō ā rātou inu kaha e whakamate ai i tētahi e rua ō rātou rahi.
Kāore he huringa o te tangata i te kēmu taketake.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.archer.de: Ka whakapaua e ngā Elf o te Rākau to rātau oranga katoa ki te whakangungu ki ngā kopere - he tino whakamate tonu a rātau pere.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.forest_vi: I a rātau e noho ana i roto i ngā rākau teitei, i ngā rau rānei, ka taea e ngā rākau rākau te piko ki te kite i te pō, kia kore ai e kitea e te tini o te iwi e tata ana.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.eagle_eye: Ka taea e ngā Elves o te Rākau te whai i tētahi hoariri mō tētahi wā poto i muri i te whakangaro i a rātau, ahakoa kāore rātau i te tirohanga.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.empowered: Whai muri i te uta i te pana mo etahi hēkona, tukua he pere me te tere ake me te tika ki te rere atu me te pono ake, ka werohia nga hoariri e rua.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.elegant.d: He iti ake te hauora o nga Wood Elves, ā, ka whakaitihia e te mau i te kākahu taumaha (Ka taea te ārai i tēnei mā te whakapā).
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.steward.d: E ora ana ngā Elf o te ngahere i roto i te ngahere, ā, kāore e taea e rātau te kai i te kikokiko.
He iti ake te teitei o ngā Elf Wood i te tangata toharite.
Ehara i te mea he kaha te rākau rākau, engari he tere, he iti ake te kino o ō whakaeke, engari he iti ake te tere.
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.name: Te whakapehapeha
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.descrip: He mea ahuareka te āhua o ngā Fae. Ka whai ngā tinihanga i a rātou i tawhiti atu i a rātau i ētahi atu mea ora.
power.medievalorigins.fae.diminutive.des: He iti rawa ngā Fae, he iti noa iho te teitei ake i te goblin toharite.
Te Whakamutua i runga i te Taputapu
E aukati ana te rino me te hiriwa i ngā mana Fae. E kore e taea e rātau te mau.
power.medievalorigins.fae.levitation.des: Ko ngā Fae he mea māmā, he mea parirau, ka taea e rātau te ngaru i runga i te rangi.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_blessi: Whakamahia ngā pūngao ora kaha mō te wā poto. I a koe e kaha ana, horahia ngā purapura ki runga i te whenua ahuwhenua kua takahia, me te tuku i te pūngao whakaora me te horoi ki ngā hoa tata.
power.medievalorigins.fae.nourishment.de: Whakanuihia te pūngao ora, ā, ka whakaranu tonu i ngā tipu i tētahi wāhi e karapoti ana i a koe.
power.medievalorigins.fae.forest_kin.des: I a koe i roto i te awhi o te ngahere, ka tere ake te whakaora i ō whara.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_ward.d: E herea ana koe ki te taiao, e hoatu ana ki a koe te ārai ki te waipiro me te ngenge, me te ātete ki ngā whakaeke makutu.
power.medievalorigins.fae.reduced_health: Ko ngā Fae he mea ngoikore, he iti ake te hauora i te tangata.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.cunning.des: He mea mohio ngā goblins, ā, e mōhio ana rātou ki te wāhi e kitea ai ngā taonga onge e kore e kitea e te nuinga o ētahi atu.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.name: He ngoikore
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.descr: Nā tō rātou āhua iti, he iti ake te hauora o ngā goblins, ā, he māmā ake ki te whara.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.name: He hiahia nui
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.desc: He hononga motuhake ngā goblins ki te taonga - ka whiwhi anō rātou i ngā bonus ina whakamahi, ina mau rānei i ngā taputapu koura.
He roa ake te roa o te koura i roto i ngā ringa o te goblin i te nuinga o ētahi atu e kore e āta whakaaro ki a ia.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.name: He māmā
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.descr: Ahakoa he iti, he tere rawa nga goblins, ka taea ai e ratou te rere atu i te nuinga o nga hoariri kaha ake i te whawhai.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.stunted.des: He iti rawa ngā goblins, he iti iho i te haurua te teitei o te tangata.
Kaore e taea e nga Gorgons te whakamana i te parakore o te wai me te tango i te kino mai i a ia.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.to_stone.de: I whakawhiwhia nga Gorgons ki te noho herea i roto i nga ana pouri me nga whare herehere tawhito. Ko te noho i waho i te marama o te ra ka meinga kia petrified ratou tae noa ki te po. Ka taea te whakakore ma te kakahu i te potae.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.silver_aver: He ngoikore nga Gorgons ki te parakore o te hiriwa - kaore e taea e ratou te mau ki te mau me te kino i te wa e mau ana. (E kiia ana hoki te rino hei hiriwa).
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.petrifying_: Me tutaki ki ngā kanohi o tētahi tinihanga e anga mai ana ki a koe, ka huri i a rātau ki te kohatu mō te wā poto. Kāore e mahi ki ngā rangatira.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.poison_bloo: He ārai ngā Gorgons ki te waikura, ā, he whai wāhi ki te tuku i tō rātou toto waikura ki runga i ngā hoariri e tata ana ina patua, ka waikura.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.revenge.des: Ka nui ake te kino o ngā Gorgon i te wā e ngoikore ana te hauora.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.elegant.d: He puhoi ake ngā High Elves mā te mau i ngā kākahu taumaha (Ka taea te ārai i tēnei mā te whakapā), ā, he iti ake te hauora.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.ebonbreat: Mā te pupuri i ngā tūemi rerekē, ka taea e ngā Elves teitei te whakawhiti i te pūngao o te ahanoa ki te tuku i ngā mana ātaahua maha.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.fragile.d: Kāore he High Elf i hangaia mō te whawhai ringa-ki-ringa. He nui ake tō rātou ngoikoretanga ki te kino ōkiko, ā, he iti ake tō rātou hauora.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mystic_af: He kaha, he mohio hoki nga Elves Nui ki te whakahaere i te pūngao arcane - he nui ake te kino o te makutu, he iti iho hoki te kino o te makutu i ētahi atu iwi.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_rpgm: He nui ake te mana o ngā High Elves i ētahi atu iwi, ā, ka taea e rātau te whakawhiti i te mana o ō rātou kaumātua ki te whakahou i te mana tere.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: He nui ake te mana o ngā High Elves i ētahi atu iwi, ā, ka taea e rātau te whakawhiti i te mana o ō rātou kaumātua ki te whakahou i te mana tere.
He nui ake te mana o ngā High Elves i ētahi atu iwi, ā, ka taea e rātau te whakawhiti i te mana o ō rātou kaumātua ki te whakahou i te mana tere.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: He nui ake te mana o ngā High Elves i ētahi atu iwi, ā, ka taea e rātau te whakawhiti i te mana o ō rātou kaumātua ki te whakahou i te mana tere.
Ko ngā High Elves he māmā, he teitei ake i te tangata toharite.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.crazed.de: Ahakoa e ngana ana rātau, kāore e taea e ngā Moon Elves te moe i roto i te ao tua atu.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.stealth.d: I roto i te pōuri, ka taea e nga Moon Elves te ngaro ma te huna, me te neke i te tawhiti poto i te wa e ngaro ana. I te whakaeke mai i te huna, ka whakawhiwhia e to raatau whakaeke tuatahi te kino bonus me te whakamutu i te kore e kitea. Ka whakawhiwhia e tenei he kino taapiri mena ka mau i te maripi.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.elegant.d: Ka whakaroa ngā Moon Elves mā te mau i ngā kākahu taumaha. Ka taea te ārai i tēnei mā te whakapā.
He kikokore, ā, he iti noa iho te mārama, ā, he kikorangi te kiri o rātau.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.fragile.d: Kua heke te hauora o ngā Elves o te Marama, ā, kua nui ake te kino ā-tinana.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.moonlight: He tino whai hua ngā Moon Elves i te whakamahi i tētahi patu māmā me te māmā ki te huna. He nui ake te kino e mahia ana e rātau ki ngā maripi me ngā maripi.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.nimble.de: Na o rātau urupare tere, he iti noa iho te tūponotanga o ngā Moon Elves ki te karo i tētahi whakaeke.
He ōrite te teitei o ngā Moon Elves ki ō rātou whanaunga tawhiti o te ngahere, nā reira he iti ake te teitei o rātau i te tangata.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.gargantuan.de: He nui rawa ngā ogre, ā, kāore e taea te uru ki roto i ngā tatau, ki roto rānei i ngā hanganga iti.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.lead_belly.de: He iti noa iho te āwangawanga o ngā ogre ki te mea e kai ana rātau. He kai tonu te kai. Kāore rātau e mate i te waipiro, i te hiakai rānei.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.name: He mea whakangahau
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.desc: Ko te nuinga o te wā e kore e makona nga ogre; e hiahia ana ratou ki te kai i te nuinga o te wā kia makona ai.'
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.name: kaiwhakangaro
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.descr: He tino pai te āhua o ngā kōhao i roto i te ringa o te Ogre; nā tēnei whakamarie e taea ai e rātau te huri me te kaha ake.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.bloodlust.des: E mōhiotia ana te rere o ngā ogre ki roto i tētahi riri matapo, e taea ai e rātau te takahi i te tini o ngā hoariri, engari kāore e taea e rātau te kite i ngā mea e tupu ana i a rātau.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.name: He puhoi
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.desc: He puhoi ake ngā ogre i te nuinga, hei tiaki i ētahi o ō rātou pūngao ahakoa o rātau rahi.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.name: He whakakakara
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.descri: Ko te kiri matotoru me ngā wheua matotoru o ngā ogres e taea ai e rātau te patu i ētahi atu.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.curse_of_fli: Ko te kanga o te Rerenga
Kaore e taea e nga Pixies te kakahu i nga pouaka nui ake i te kiri, kaore hoki e taea te whakamahi i etahi atu parirau ki te rere rereke.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.feather_foot: He māmā rawa ngā Pixies, e kore e taea e rātau te tango i te kino o te hinga.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.name: I runga i ngā puehu
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.descr:
Ka taea e ngā Pixies te rere me te akiaki i a rātou anō ki mua, ki runga anō hoki.
Pānuitia ngā pouaka i te taha o tēnei mana mō ngā tohutohu e pā ana ki te āhua o te rere.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.name: He rori poto
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.descri: Ka taea e koe te noho ki runga ake i te upoko o tētahi kaitākaro mā te pāwhiri matau ki a rātau me ngā ringa kore.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.good_fortune: Ahakoa ka taea e nga pixies te raruraru, ka honoa ano hoki ki te waimarie pai. I te wa e keri ana, ka whiwhi i etahi wa i tetahi mea nui mai i te kohatu noa.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.pixie_proper: Ko nga Pixies etahi o nga mea iti rawa e haereere ana i te whenua, he iti noa iho te tae ki te turi o te tangata toharite.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.name: Kua whakaranua
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.descr: I te mea he iti noa iho, he tino mōrearea te wai ki ngā pixies. E aukati ana i a rātau nekehanga, e whakaraerae ana hoki i a rātau kaha ki te rere.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.troublemaker: E mōhio ana ngā tangata o te kainga ki ngā pixies mā ngā kōrero o ngā raruraru e meinga ana e rātau, ā, ka whakakahore ki te hokohoko ki a rātau.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.cont: He mea whakamataku te kitenga o ngā Raruraru. Ka whakakahore ngā kainoho ki te hokohoko ki a rātau i te wehi.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.foul: He makutu whakamataku e pā ana ki te patunga tapu, ā, he puhoi te kai i te ora o te hunga katoa e noho tata ana.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.inso: E kore e taea te moe mō te hunga e matea ana, nā tō rātou mamae mutungakore.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.plag: Te ārai i te mate uruta
Ahakoa e kore e mutu te mamae nui, he iti noa iho te kiko ka mate.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.eter: Kotahi i ia rima meneti, i muri i te matenga, ka noho ora tonu te hunga mate kia roa ai to ratou whakamamae.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.risk: I ngā wā katoa e patu ai koe, he tūponotanga ki te horahanga o te mate.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.sens: Kei te taupokina te kiri o te hunga e mate ana e ngā whara me ngā whara, he māmā, he mamae hoki ki te pa. Kāore e taea e ōna patunga tinana te whakakakahu mō te mamae e puta mai ana.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.skin: Mā tēnei mate e whakawātea te wairua, ā, ka heke te hauora me te tere.
power.medievalorigins.siren.amphibious.d: I roto i te wai, ka taea e nga sirens te manawa me te whakawhitiwhiti kōrero, kia tino mārama te kite, ā, ka nui ake te tere o te kaukau.
power.medievalorigins.siren.flammable.de: Kāore e taea te whakakotahi i te ahi me te pupuhi. Ko tētahi pānga ki te mura ka puta he mate tata tonu.
power.medievalorigins.siren.holy_water.d: He tere ake te whakahoutanga o ngā tinana o ngā sirens, engari i te wā anake e tino ruku ana.
power.medievalorigins.siren.out_of_your_: I a rātau i te whenua, ka taea anake e ngā Sirens te whakaora, te whakahou rānei mā te whakamahi i ngā rongoā.
power.medievalorigins.siren.siren_song.n: Ko te Waiata a ngā Sirens
power.medievalorigins.siren.siren_song.d: Ka whakahohehia hei patu i ngā hoariri i roto i tētahi rohe nui, e ārai ana i a rātou i te kino ki a koe mō te wā poto. Kāore e mahi ki ngā rangatira, ki ngā kaitākaro rānei.
power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.name: He mea whakamiharo
power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.descr: Patohia te pātene mahi tuarua kia pai ai te manako ki te tangata o te kainga, kia pai ake ai ngā mahi mai i a rātou.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.flammable.des: Ko ngā Yeti he māmā ki te pāngia e te ahi nā te āhua o te hotoke.
Ko te Ngaro o te Ngaro
Ka taea e te Yeti te tanu i ngā hoariri tata ki te hukapapa i runga i te whakahau. Kāore e mahi i roto i te raro, i runga i ngā rangatira rānei.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.from_whence_y: No hea koe i haere mai ai
I roto i ngā koiora hukapapa, ka tere ake te nekehanga me te whakakore i te kino o te hinganga.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.frosty_breath: Ko te manawa makariri o te yeti e whakaroa ana i ngā hoariri e whakatata ana ki a rātau.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.thick_fur.des: I roto i nga koraha, ka waiho te huruhuru matotoru hei kanga - ka puhoi te nekehanga o te Yeti, ka whakaiti i te hauora
power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.name: Ko te Titanic
power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.descr: He nui ake te hauora o ngā Yeti i te tangata noa.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.unstoppable.d: He ārai ngā Yeti ki te pānga puhoi.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.winter_body.d: He iti ake te teitei o ngā Yeti i te tangata noa, ā, he nui ake te whanui.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.command_s: Whakahaua tō taua whawhai undead karanga (e kore hoiho) ki te whai, noho, ranei teleport ki a koutou.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.black_thu: Kāore e taea e tētahi Revenant te kokoti i ngā hua; ka maroke rātou i tō rātou pa ki te mate.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.disturbed: Ko te whakamātautau i te mea aukatia e whakaraerae ana i te hinengaro. Kāore e taea e te hunga e hoki mai ana te moe, e mataku ana ki te moemoea i ngā mea e hiahia ana rātau kia kore e mōhiotia.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.hellraise: I te hiahia, ka taea e te kaiwhakawhiwhi te whakaara ake i tetahi porowhita o nga wheua kore, e mahi ana hei whakangungu mo te wa poto hei tiaki ia ratou i te morearea me te kino o nga hoariri e tata ana.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.unwithera: Ko te kanga o te mate

He ārai ngā Revenants ki te pirau, ā, pēnei i te undead, ka nui ake te kino i te whiu, ka riro i a rātau ngā pānga hurihuri mai i ngā pānga kino me ngā pānga whakaora, ā, ka ārai i ngā pānga haurangi me te whakahoutanga.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.putrid_co:
Na roto i te mahi whakamataku o te kai i te kikokiko, i ngā wheua rānei o te hunga mate-kore, ka taea e tētahi kaiwhakawhiwhi te whakamana i a rātau tono e whai ake nei o taua momo.. 
Mō ngā mea whawhai, whakawhānui i tō rātou roa, kia mau tonu ai ki te mana mōrahi. Mō ngā hoiho mate-kore, whakarei ake i ō rātou āhuatanga ki te mana mōrahi.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.skeleton_: Ka taea e ngā Revenants te hanga anō i ngā mea hanga o te pō kua whakarerekētia hei mahi i ō rātou ake tono. Ka mahi ēnei hei kararehe, ka whai, ka whakawhitiwhiti, ā, ka taea te whakanoho i ngā patu, i ngā kākahu rānei. Kāore e taea e ngā zombies te whakamahi i ngā kopere. Whakawhitihia ngā tohu mō ngā taipitopito.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.poor_repu: Ka whakakahore nga kainoho ki te hokohoko me nga kainoho, ka whakaekea e nga golem rino i te kitenga.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon.de: I te wā e patua ana, ka āta hangaia e ngā Revenant tētahi mana e āhei ai rātau ki te hopu i te ora i ō rātou hoariri. E pā ana tēnei ki ngā mea ora katoa, pai, kino rānei, haunga ngā mea mate i karangatia.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.unguarded: Ko te āwangawanga ki runga i te ao wairua, ka nui ake te āwangawanga ki ngā whakaeke i roto i te ao tūturu.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.wings.des: He nui ngā parirau o te Valkyrie, he ma, ā, ka rere noa.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.intervent:
Whakatere ki runga ki te rangi, rere ki mua rānei mēnā kei te rere kē koe, kia kore ai koe e hinga tae noa ki te taunga. 

I te taunga, i muri rānei i te 10 hēkona, patua te rohe ki te pūngao tapu, horoi i ngā pānga kino mai i ngā hoa tata, me te whakaora i a rātou, me te whakaheke i ngā tāngata ehara i te hoa..
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.divine_sm: I ia whakaeke tuatoru, patua ngā hoariri e tata ana.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.corruptio: Ka ngoikore, ka pōhēhē hoki koe e ngā tini tangata mate-kore e tata ana, ā, ka nui ake te kino e pā ana ki a koe i ō rātou whakaeke.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.vanquishe: I muri i te whakamate i tētahi rōpū undead, whakahohe i te §nDivine Smite§r§r§r me te whakaiti iti iho i ngā pānga o te §nCorruption§r mō ia tangata i patua.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.heavenly_: He kaha ake te mana whakaora o nga Valkyrie, he kaha ake hoki ki nga patu e rite ana ki te tao me te tao.
enchantment.medievalorigins.featherweigh: Ka taea te whakamahi i tēnei whakapā ki ngā kākahu taumaha hei ārai i te whakaroa i ngā Arachnae, Elves, Alfiq, ngā mea parirau rānei.
enchantment.medievalorigins.mirroring.de: Mā tēnei makutu e whakamahia ana ki ngā potae, ka ārai ngā kaitākaro i te titiro whakamataku a te Gorgon, ā, ka taea e ngā Dwarf te kite i te marama o te rā.

badges.medievalorigins.high_elf.instant_: §e Instant Cure: §r Pāwhiri matau i te tangata kāinga me te aporo koura ki te whakawhiti tika i tōna pūngao whakaora, me te kore e hiahiatia kia ngoikore rātou

badges.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon: Pā atu ki tētahi mea ora hei whakawātea i tōna kaha ora.
badges.medievalorigins.revenant.eat: I tua atu i ngā wheua me te kikokiko pirau, ka tere ake te utu o tēnei rauemi mā te kai i ētahi upoko whakamataku.
badges.medievalorigins.alfiq.wall_climb: Patohia te %s hei huri i te piki i te pakitara.

medievalorigins.disturbed_restless: Ka mate koe i ngā mea e mōhio ana koe, engari ka mate koe i te kata.
medievalorigins.moon_elf_no_sleep: Ko ngā haruru rerekē o tēnei ao kē e whakararuraru ana i a koe.
medievalorigins.insomniac_welts: E kore koe e moe i te pō nei.
medievalorigins.poor_reputation_villager: He mataku rawa te tangata o te kainga ki te hokohoko ki a koe!
medievalorigins.poor_reputation_block: Kāore he kainoho e pai ana ki te hokohoko ki a koe!
medievalorigins.troublemaker: Kāore ngā kainoho e hokohoko ki te hunga pēnei i a koe!
medievalorigins.uncastable: Kāore e taea e koe te whakamahi i tēnei āheinga i tēnei wā.

He nui ake te pūkenga o ngā High Elves i roto i tētahi āhuatanga, i whakaritea i te whanautanga. 

He kaikauwhau kua pau i te mana o te mea ngaro me te kore e mohiotia.

- 16 Ngā Rune Arcane
